record.field: When a payment of OCD Business is confirmed
The payment confirmed by its provider, or checked by the team.
The vendors who buy OCD Business.
Add the days bought after the end of the formula (or from today), once per payment. Make the invoice of the payment. Tell the vendor until when.
Sales, Invoicing, code of OCD Live.
The date of end of each formula, at the hour of the vendor; the day of the launch.

Remind the vendor the days of the settings before the end, then the day before, once per date of end. At the end, tell what is paused (nothing is erased). The day of the launch, offer the months of the settings to the vendors who use the features, then stop the features offered to all.
